statement: The classification owner gains a deterministic impact proof-cone selector: given a changed-file set it selects tests by the union of generated static reverse-dependency closure, generated observed-coverage edges with a freshness bound, and explicit semantic contract edges; applies sealed escalation tiers that force the full suite for selector/runner self-changes and unknown or unclassified paths; always includes the universal safety floor; and emits a versioned selection-rationale receipt binding the exact inputs.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
